scripts.local-energy:verify: pnpm validate && pnpm prisma:doctor && pnpm prisma:validate && pnpm prisma:generate && turbo run typecheck
scripts.prisma:push: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma db push --config prisma.config.ts && pnpm prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate dev --config prisma.config.ts && pnpm prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate deploy --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:status: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate status --config prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:reset: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate reset --config prisma.config.ts && pnpm prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:init: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate dev --config prisma.config.ts --name init && pnpm prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:create: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate dev --config prisma.config.ts --create-only
scripts.prisma:migrate:baseline:create: mkdir -p prisma/migrations/0_init && prisma migrate diff --config prisma.config.ts --from-empty --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --script --output prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql
scripts.prisma:migrate:baseline:resolve: pnpm prisma:doctor && prisma migrate resolve --config prisma.config.ts --applied 0_init
